Heard on I.A. No.10841/2025, which is first application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C./430(1)
of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to
appellant Rambabu Ahirwar.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 16.04.2025 passed by the learned learned 2nd Additional Sessions, Judge/Special Judge, (POCSO), Garhakota, District Sagar, in S.C. No.19/2022,
whereby, appellant Rambabu has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Conviction Sentence

Section Act Imprisonment Fine Im  3/4 POCSO R.I. for 20 years Rs.20,000/- R.
 376 I.P.C. - - -
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the DNA report (Ex.P/41) is negative qua appellant Rambabu Ahirwar, and it is positive against co-accused Manish @ Basant Ahirwar.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri S.K. Shrivastva, Government Advocate supports the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant Rambabu Ahirwar and release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court 18.12.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant Rambabu Ahirwar shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
C.C. as per rules.
 (VIVEK AGARWAL) (AVANINDRA KU  JUDGE JUDG  NRJ Rambahu Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 27 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77273399/
